cases.name: names the cause in our code and a fix with a test
untrusted:
PROBLEM WT-7KQ2M4
Kind: Failed job
Title: RuntimeException: Bank token expired for payout [id]
Error class: RuntimeException
Where: job Modules\Payouts\Jobs\SendPayout
Origin: modules/Payouts/src/Rails/PayoutSender.php:40
Happened 12 times (12 in the last hour), at 3 brokerages, first in release v1.4.0, last in v1.4.0.
Trace:
modules/Payouts/src/Rails/PayoutSender.php:40
#0 modules/Payouts/src/Jobs/SendPayout.php:31 Modules\Payouts\Rails\PayoutSender->send()
EARLIER PROBLEMS IN THE SAME FILE: none
cases.golden: {"summary": "Payouts to agents fail at 3 brokerages because the saved bank token has expired.", "cause": "PayoutSender.php line 40 throws when the saved token is past its expiry; nothing refreshes it first.", "fix": "Refresh the token before sending when it has expired, and add a test that sends a payout with an expired token.", "severity": "critical", "confidence": "medium"}

Kind: Browser error
Title: Browser: ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications.
Where: page /dashboard
Happened 6 times (1 in the last hour), at 2 brokerages, first in release v1.4.0, last in v1.4.0.

cases.golden: {"summary": "A harmless browser warning on the dashboard; nothing stops working for anyone.", "cause": "A chart resizes while the page lays out, which browsers report as a ResizeObserver loop. No code was shown, so this is a guess.", "fix": "Ignore this warning in the browser error reporter, or wrap the chart resize in requestAnimationFrame; a test is not needed.", "severity": "normal", "confidence": "low"}

cases.name: treats one brokerage seeing another's data as critical
untrusted:
PROBLEM WT-9Z8Y7X
Kind: Server error
Title: AuthorizationException: Document [id] belongs to another brokerage
Error class: Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException
Where: GET roster/documents/{document} (roster.documents.show)
Origin: modules/Roster/src/Http/DocumentController.php:52
Happened 4 times (4 in the last hour), at 1 brokerages, first in release v1.4.0, last in v1.4.0.
It was marked fixed in v1.3.9 and has come back.

EARLIER PROBLEMS IN THE SAME FILE:
- Roster document downloaded by another brokerage (fixed, fixed in v1.3.9)
cases.golden: {"summary": "A brokerage tried to open another brokerage's roster document; the check stopped it, but the same bug fixed in v1.3.9 has come back.", "cause": "DocumentController.php line 50 reads the document without the tenant_id condition, so the id alone finds another brokerage's file before line 52 refuses it.", "fix": "Add where('tenant_id', ...) to the query on line 50 (or use the Eloquent model with the tenant scope), and add a test where a second brokerage asks for the first one's document and gets a 404.", "severity": "critical", "confidence": "high"}
